<?php
// Local Playground only (dev/blueprint.json): opening wp-admin or the login screen signs you in as the admin.
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( is_user_logged_in() || wp_doing_ajax() || wp_doing_cron() || ( defined( 'REST_REQUEST' ) && REST_REQUEST ) ) {
		return;
	}
	$uri = isset( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ? (string) $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] : '';
	if ( false === strpos( $uri, '/wp-admin' ) && false === strpos( $uri, '/wp-login.php' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	if ( false !== strpos( $uri, 'action=logout' ) ) {
		return;
	}
	wp_set_current_user( 1 );
	wp_set_auth_cookie( 1, true );
	$to = isset( $_GET['redirect_to'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_GET['redirect_to'] ) : ( false !== strpos( $uri, '/wp-admin' ) ? $uri : admin_url() );
	wp_safe_redirect( $to );
	exit;
} );
